list: Official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026). Guides written for this entry in our own words, each with its sources.

roadmap.text: Chapters 1 to 5, in order. Every chapter and mission trophy pops here, plus the partner trophies that need Jason and Lucia together. Do Lucia's balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth in Chapter 1: that one step may be needed for Positive Mental Attitude and it is gone after the chapter. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, because there is no mission replay.
roadmap.title: Play the story

roadmap.text: Finish the character quest lines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) and 8 stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count toward Strangers & Freaks; the character quest lines do not. None of these need 100% completion, and all stay open after the story, so take them at your own pace.
roadmap.title: Side quests and strangers

roadmap.text: Work through the counted trophies: 250 stunts (300 for 100%), 42 shooting range golds, 14 drone race locations, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 vehicles, 18 meditations (15 for 100%), 3 card sets, 52 explored areas, 9 gangs. Turn on progress and collectible notifications in Settings so nothing is missed.
roadmap.title: Collectibles and activities

roadmap.text: After the credits, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and clear what is left: robberies, 8 bank vaults (5 for the trophy), 39 gang operations, underwater finds, 70 of 80 challenges. A Long Road (100%) is the last big trophy; the platinum pops with it.
roadmap.title: Clean-up and the platinum

gtavicecityhub.name: GTA Vice City Hub: GTA 6 Achievements

pressstart.name: Press-Start: Full Trophy/Achievement List for GTA 6

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to chase. Treat it as a progress meter rather than a goal: the real work is A Long Road, the 100% completion gold, which is the last big trophy for almost every player. Budget roughly 200 hours in total, and expect most of that time to fall in the clean-up stage after the story ends, when the counted trophies and collectibles are left.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Finish A Long Road (100% completion) last.
The platinum pops automatically once the 54th is earned.

trophies.guide: A story trophy from one of the first missions of Chapter 1. Play Gone Fishing through to its end and the trophy pops when the mission completes. It cannot be missed: every player passes through this mission by following the story, and there is no optional objective attached to it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start Chapter 1 and follow the story missions.
Play Gone Fishing to the end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy is awarded as Chapter 2 begins. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing that might not come back: the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. That step may be needed for Positive Mental Attitude, and it disappears once the chapter ends, so do not rush past it.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play every Chapter 1 mission in order.
The morning after Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia on the balcony.
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops as Chapter 2 starts.

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 2 through to its end; the trophy is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after the Welcome to Vice City mission. This is the chapter where Jason and Lucia both become playable, which opens up the partner trophies, so from here on you can switch characters and hunt the trophies that need the two of them together.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play every Chapter 2 mission in order.
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops as Chapter 3 begins.
Both characters are now playable for partner trophies.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 and the trophy follows. Robberies and side quest lines open up during this chapter, so start the character quests (Andy, Randy, Tyrone) and the jewelry jobs as they appear instead of leaving them all for the post-story clean-up. Spreading them out also keeps the later stages shorter.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play every Chapter 3 mission in order.
Start the character quests and jewelry jobs as they appear.
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops as Chapter 4 starts.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and the trophy is yours. The first two missions of Chapter 4 set up the chapter trophies that follow, and the bank vault robberies unlock in this chapter, so try the optional mission That's Where The Money Is when it shows up: it opens the vaults you need for Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% list.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play every Chapter 4 mission in order.
Take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is when it appears.
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops as Chapter 5 starts.

trophies.guide: A gold story trophy for finishing the last mission of the game. Free roam carries on after the credits, so nothing else depends on how you play this mission, and no trophy is locked behind the ending. Still, make a manual save before it: with no mission replay, a save is your only way back to the story if you ever want to replay a chapter.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Make a manual save before the final mission.
Play the final mission to the end.
The gold trophy pops with the credits.

trophies.guide: A Chapter 2 mission trophy. Complete Breakfast Run and it pops when the mission ends, so there is nothing extra to do and nothing to miss. Just keep playing the story in order and it comes to you.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at the mission end screen.

trophies.guide: A Chapter 3 mission trophy. Complete The Cartel Heist and the trophy follows when the mission ends; no extra objective is needed, and the mission cannot be skipped, so every story playthrough earns it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at the mission end screen.

trophies.guide: A Chapter 4 mission trophy. Complete Child's Play and it unlocks when the mission is done. There is no hidden requirement: finishing the mission is the whole trophy.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach Child's Play in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at the mission end screen.

trophies.guide: A Chapter 4 mission trophy. Complete Headliners by playing the mission through to its end; there is no side objective to chase and no way to miss it, since the mission is part of the main story path.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach Headliners in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at the mission end screen.

trophies.guide: A Chapter 4 mission trophy for completing VCIA Takedown. The same airport is where the Catch Me If You Can trophy is earned later in free roam, so pay attention to the layout while you play the mission: the gates, the fences and the boarding bridges all come back when you steal a jet.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.
Note the airport layout for Catch Me If You Can later.

trophies.guide: A late-story mission trophy from Chapter 5. Complete Operation Savage Glory and the trophy is earned by finishing the mission, like the other mission trophies before it. Nothing extra is required, and the story continues from there to the finale.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at the mission end screen.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list and the gate to the platinum. After the story, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion: everything you did before already counts, and nothing on the list is missable. It asks for all robberies (including 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations), underwater discoveries, every shooting range gold, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks, plus a share of the rest: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Work through the checklist in the game itself, not from memory, and tick it off stage by stage.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
Clear every robbery, vault and gang operation first.
Work the counted lists: ranges, races, stunts, scans, challenges.
The gold pops when the checklist reads 100%.

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to add to the total, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed for the count. Check Progress, Activities, Stunts for your running total, and use the map's Stunt Spot markers to find the next ones. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 rather than stopping.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Open Progress, Activities, Stunts to see your count.
Fly under bridges and hit stunt jumps to add to the total.
Reach 250 stunts; keep going to 300 for 100%.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Progress, Activities shows what is left. Most of them happen naturally while you play; golf and pool are the ones to seek out on purpose, since nothing in the story forces you to try them.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Check Progress, Activities for the types still untried.
Play golf and pool on purpose; the rest come naturally.
The trophy pops once all 9 types are tried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges. Take your time and learn each range's target pattern before chasing the gold time; ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger later. This is one of the few trophies the 100% checklist needs in full, so there is no way around it: all 42 golds are required either way.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit each of the 12 shooting ranges.
Learn each challenge's target pattern, then chase gold.
Earn all 42 gold medals.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so it is worth finishing every race at a location while you are there instead of coming back later. Learn the racing line at each spot and the wins come quickly.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location.
Win one race there; repeat at all 14 locations.
Finish every race at a spot while you are there, for 100%.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; there are 40 to choose from across Leonida. Winning the same race again does not count, so vary the events instead of repeating your favourite. Car races, race challenges and drone races all count, and they also count toward the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter races from the map and activity markers.
Win 20 different events; repeats do not count.
Mix car races, race challenges and drone races.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests, then beat him in his challenge. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so it pulls double duty on your way to the platinum.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Meet Cal in Feng Shui (Chapter 1).
Follow his texts to the marked fishing spot.
Play his fishing quests, then beat him in his challenge.

trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind) are on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick the game you find easiest and play it to the end; finishing any one of the four is enough.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Pick an arcade game: three are on the TV at home.
Play it through to the end.
The trophy pops when the game ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. The last one awards the trophy. They stay available after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Wait for Andy's text in Chapter 3 (Lucia only).
Do his five quests in order.
Puff Puff Pass, the last one, awards the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton (green KR icon in Key Lento) hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then. Track it under Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Meet Kenton in Key Lento (Chapter 1).
Dive at the 7 purple chest markers; use the metal detector.
Finish his last recovery to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy. They stay available after the story, so work through them whenever you are in the area.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub after Coffee Break (Chapter 2).
Do Billy's five jobs in order.
Hometown Heroes, the fifth, awards the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list as you go. None of them are needed for 100%, and all stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Find stranger strands across Leonida (map markers).
Finish 8 qualifying strands; Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count.
Check the trophy counter to confirm your progress.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good places to look. Cars in better condition pay more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Get the Key Cloner in Chapter 3, then check Randy's Wish List.
Scan sports cars with WAiNK to find the 16 on his list.
Deliver each one to his garage in west Vice City.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job (Shut Down the Labs) awards the trophy. The labs stay marked on the map, so work through them in any order you like.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Finish Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 (Jason only).
Destroy the purple-marked synthetic labs around Vice City.
Complete Shut Down the Labs, his last job.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. The last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. Warning: this is the one trophy that may be missable. In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do not skip it.
trophies.missableNote: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after the chapter. Do it the morning after Down to Earth.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia on the balcony.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), meditate at spots with both characters.
Track the counter under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations until it reads 18.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so work through them all and this one comes with them.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Wait for Bret's text after Coffee Break (Chapter 2).
Start Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Hunt the Target Deck animals (purple icons) as Jason.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets; you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is, so chase the sets you are already nearest to finishing. Cards are found around Leonida, so pick up every set you can while exploring for other trophies and the total builds up without a dedicated hunt.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Open Progress, Collections to see each set's progress.
Pick up cards while exploring for other trophies.
Complete any 3 sets.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scan as you travel and the total builds up on its own; the 100% checklist wants 100 as well, so this trophy and the checklist line up exactly.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB).
Scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags as you travel.
Reach 100 scanned locations.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress, Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way. If you are short near the end, open the Challenges menu and pick the easiest unfinished ones first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open Progress, Challenges to see what is ticked.
Keep playing; many challenges finish on their own.
Pick the easiest unfinished ones to reach 50 (70 for 100%).

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape. It only counts once you are out of the red heat zone, so keep moving until the heat clears. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there without a dedicated attempt.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), call your partner.
Build a 4-star Wanted Level.
Escape until you are out of the red heat zone.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items so you survive the heat. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are close together, which makes the run short. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Bring your partner and stock up on armor and healing items.
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing your Wanted Level.
Wait about 30 seconds; if it does not pop, rob a fourth.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic, and the total climbs fast. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway while working toward that, but a short scanning session on a busy street finishes it early.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Open the WAiNK app near a busy road.
Scan passing traffic; each new model counts.
Reach 100 different vehicles (200 for 100%).

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer) and use an assault rifle for the fastest kills. Gang operation thugs work well as targets; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count, so pick your fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home).
Start a gang operation, then trigger Combat Focus while aiming.
Take down 5 thugs before the Focus runs out.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge (planes parked out on the airfield do not count). Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and head for gates E3 or E4.
Board a jet docked at a boarding bridge.
Take off and fly about 1 km from the airport.

trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County (the tanks are at the south end of the base) and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the way in, so go in with armor and a plan to get out, and do not stop to fight on foot once you have the tank.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, Mariana County.
Take a tank from the south end of the base.
Take out enemies from inside the tank until it pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door (kicking it in sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City works well. Move slowly, stay out of sight lines, and leave the way you came.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Get the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3).
Open a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun, not a kick.
Find the safe code note, empty the safe, leave unseen.

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles to shake the heat. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 if you want the next target marked.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Do That's Where The Money Is (Chapter 4) to open vaults.
Follow a security van to its bank and enter the vault.
Hand a bag to your partner, escape on a fast bike, repeat 5 times.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault counts for this one too, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray. Before vaults open up, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away. Either route works, so take whichever comes first in your playthrough.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Box in an armored truck (or rob a bank vault).
Sticky-bomb the truck's back doors and take the cash.
Escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida: 52 areas in total. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch until the map fills in. Do this while you travel for other trophies and the map fills in on its own; a dedicated flyover at the end finishes the last corners. The in-game map shows which areas are still fogged.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Travel widely while hunting other trophies.
Take a plane over any dark patches left on the map.
Keep going until all 52 areas are revealed.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress, Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so keep robbing them after this trophy pops. Operations stay open after the story, and each one pays, so they are worth doing even past the trophy.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find yellow gang-operation icons on the map.
Rob one operation from each of the 9 gangs.
Check Progress, Gangs to see which gangs are left.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. The exact bar or interaction is not confirmed yet at launch: walk the Ocean Beach front, look for a bar or cocktail spot with a view, and order a drink there. This guide will be updated as players confirm the spot, so check the sources beside this trophy for the latest word.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Walk the Ocean Beach front in Vice City.
Find a bar or cocktail spot with a view.
Order a cocktail there.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom, a nod to the classic GTA opening. The exact showroom and steps are not confirmed yet at launch: try driving a car through a showroom's front glass in Vice City, and watch for the trophy as you break through. This guide will be updated as players confirm it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Find a vehicle showroom in Vice City.
Drive a car through its front glass.
The trophy should pop as you smash out.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back, so take them all if you can.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2 onward).
Take the watch, the shotgun and the safe's contents.
Lose the police; the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason and Lucia, Strength in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map, Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too, so bring your partner to every session. After the story you can also train at home, which makes the last levels easy to finish.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Find a fitness club (Map, Activities).
Work out with your partner along.
Max out Strength for both characters.

trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI to watch the count climb as you play. Do not push towards the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent, so let the count grow from ordinary play rather than chasing the worst choices.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings, UI).
Keep playing; profile-changing actions add up.
The trophy pops at 500 actions.

trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. The exact trigger is not confirmed yet at launch: it most likely pops when you pass something you failed once before, so if you fail an activity or challenge, try it again right away instead of moving on. This guide will be updated as players confirm it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: If you fail an activity or challenge, retry it right away.
Pass it on the second attempt.
The trophy should pop on the retry.

trophies.guide: Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida. The exact trigger is not confirmed yet at launch: explore the odd corners of the map and watch for something out of the ordinary, and check the sources beside this trophy for what other players have found. This guide will be updated as players confirm it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners and hidden spots.
Watch for a strange event or Easter egg.
Check the cited sources for the latest confirmed trigger.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle (a melee drive-by). The exact steps are not confirmed yet at launch: drive slowly past pedestrians and swing a melee weapon from the vehicle, and the trophy should pop when the hit lands. This guide will be updated as players confirm it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a vehicle and a melee weapon.
Drive slowly past pedestrians.
Swing the melee weapon from the vehicle to knock one down.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there without a dedicated grind: just fence everything you steal.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Get the Dye Pack Jammer in Credit Check (Chapter 3).
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Sell the bills to fences (Yasmani pays most) until $250,000.

trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest. It counts all spending, so it builds up naturally over a full playthrough; if you are short at the end, buy weapon mods or car upgrades, which are the quickest way to close the gap.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend across any shops as you play.
Guns, car mods and tattoos count fastest.
If short at the end, buy weapon mods or car upgrades.

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count, so only bought ones count toward the 8. You need the garage space for the Scooter Bros registrations too, so buy them before finishing On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Open Vice City Real Estate after Daily Driver (Chapter 2).
Buy all 8 garages for sale (about $160,000 total).
Buy them before finishing On the Spot.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Get the Scooter Bros app from Moses (Chapter 2).
Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn.
Respray and register 10 of them (use cheap cars and bikes).
